name: The Deathstalkers
summary: In the Undercity, Mennet Carkad tests hopeful Deathstalkers with a demand for ruthless initiative: intercept a traveling messenger. The trial opens the way into the covert order serving Lord Varimathras.

sections.title: A Test in the Shadows
sections.body: The Deathstalkers serve Varimathras as the Forsaken's secret police and elite assassination corps. In the Rogues' Quarter, handler Mennet Carkad sets a trial for anyone seeking a place among them. A hopeful agent must show cunning, discretion, and the will to eliminate a target. Carkad's test is meant to turn away the weak and those troubled by too many scruples.

sections.title: The Interception
sections.body: Astor Hadren carries a letter along the road between the Undercity and Silverpine Forest. Carkad leaves the approach to the recruit. To secure Hadren's personal introduction, the initiate must intercept him and seize his credentials, so the Deathstalkers can pass their recruit off in his place to Andron.

faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's covert order and elite stealth and assassination branch. From the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity, they handle espionage, covert executions, and information gathering, reporting to Lord Varimathras.
Mennet Carkad is a Deathstalker handler in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He oversees early trials and tests recruits hoping to join the covert ranks.

faq.q: Why does Mennet need Astor Hadren's letter?
faq.answer: Astor Hadren's letter of introduction lets a new operative take his place. The Deathstalkers can use it to deceive Andron.
Astor Hadren travels the road between the Undercity and Silverpine Forest, carrying correspondence for his contacts.

Lord Varimathras is a Nathrezim dreadlord who allied with Queen Sylvanas Windrunner to preserve his own existence. From the Royal Quarter, he oversees the Undercity's security, defense, and rogue operations.
Passing the trial proves an operative's competence. It leads to a covert impersonation assignment: deliver Astor's papers and infiltrate Andron's dealings.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, joining the Deathstalkers means reaching the highest echelon of state service, where streetwise scoundrels become sworn instruments of Varimathras and the Dark Lady.

As an undead, you see the Deathstalkers enforce Lordaeron's internal security with an iron grip. They watch for external foes and keep a watchful, paranoid eye on potential traitors within the Forsaken.

As a member of the Horde, you may not know how deeply the Deathstalkers operate in secrecy. They maintain vital intelligence networks while the Horde's southern allies remain largely unaware of the Forsaken's shadier domestic affairs.
